\par\smallskip\begin{minipage}{\linewidth}\scriptsize\textit{Notes:} Scores of the 5 platforms of La Libertad Avanza (red diamonds), filed with the C\'amara Nacional Electoral and scored out of sample with the identical pipeline and aggregation rule as the baseline (CF = Capital Federal, BA = Buenos Aires province; 2023 = national platform, filed for the primaries (PASO) and the general election), and of the Republican Party platforms (teal squares; baseline manifestos; 2020 re-adopted the 2016 platform), ordered by election date.
